title.narrative: Solar photovoltaic technology transfer from China to Fiji and the wider region of Pacific Island Countries and Territories

description.narrative: This project is funded by the UNIDO China Voluntary Fund, which aims at the promotion of south-south knowledge and technology transfer between China and developing countries. The project#s development objective is to promote sustainable social, economic and environmental development in Fiji and the wider region of the Pacific Islands and Territories (PICTs) through increased use of solar PV technology solutions. Specifically, the project will lead to the design of a comprehensive south-south PV technology transfer program from China to PICTs. The program will be developed in close consultation with local counterparts and in partnership with Chinese investors, financiers and technology providers. The program will also address the identified policy barriers for the introduction of PV solutions in PICTs. To demonstrate the feasibility and viability of innovative Chinese PV technology under tropical island conditions concretely, the project includes also the installation of two (2) highly visible pilot solar photovoltaic (PV) systems in Fiji (to be selected from a short-list of four identified sites ranging from 10kWp to 40kWp).
